as_told.title: Mussolini asks Hitler about the Magenta craft

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels, talking with a former presidential advisor, says that an object crashed in Italy around 1933, and that it is known as the Magenta object. According to Michels, the story goes that Italy's dictator Benito Mussolini then went to Adolf Hitler in Germany and the two formed a partnership over it. If true, it would mean that a crashed craft was being studied by governments well before the Second World War.
